complianceLedger.promptRefinementSummary: Master orthographic right-facing profile establishing 709-710 px baseline height and outfit colors.
Right-leg heel-strike, near right arm swung backward (-38 deg), far left arm forward (+45 deg); exposes 100% unobstructed torso and pelvis.
REJECTED for X01 near-arm-forward target: asking for unobstructed torso caused open-torso side-profile bias (model kept near arm in rear swing). Refined in Calls #78 -> #80.
Vertical stance support + elevated high-knee swing pass; isolates horizontal ponytail and airborne swing shoe in pure #FF00FF magenta.
Airborne peak split-stride (507 px span); isolates high forward-reaching farUpperArm and maximum rear split thigh extension.

REJECTED for X01 near-shoulder-forward target: asking for #FF00FF gap between chest and upper arm caused model to attach forward arm to far shoulder and transfer cyan wristband onto far arm (IMG-ERR-18). Refined in Call #80.

REJECTED for X05 grounded forefoot bend (high-knee jump caused airborne pointed toe, IMG-ERR-19; refined in Call #81). ACCEPTED for X04 90-deg horizontal high-knee thigh/shin and X06 horizontal airborne ponytail whip.

Single-variable shoulder-topology refinement of Call #78: near right deltoid/upper-arm angles forward across upper chest with cyan wristband + lateral thumb-up fist ahead of torso (X01), while far left medial arm swings backward behind back (X03).

Single-variable grounded-stance refinement of Call #79: trailing support shoe planted on forefoot ball with 45-deg heel lift (X05 plantar-toe-off) and leading shoe in +25-deg dorsiflexed heel-strike preparation.

Replaced literal "unclothed" overhead prompt (dropped by safety filter in Call #82, IMG-ERR-20) with minimalist matte-black sports bra + high-cut bikini brief + barefoot/bare-wristed orthogonal angles: 0-deg horizontal near arm, 90-deg vertical bare thigh, 180-deg horizontal rear hamstring-curl calf.

Direct test of literal "unclothed" prompt: safety filter rewrote attire to black sports bra + mid-thigh bike shorts (IMG-ERR-20, Refined in Call #84 with high-cut bikini brief). ACCEPTED for bare-wrist -90-deg vertical upward far medial forearm, 175-deg straight rear near arm, and 45-deg tiptoe bare foot.

Opposite Angle Matrix C in high-cut bikini brief + barefoot/bare-wristed: +60-deg straight-knee front-kick bare thigh/shin (spanW=572 px), -40-deg rear bare medial thigh, 90-deg rear near arm, and +20-deg low-forward far medial forearm.
